definitions.explanation: Applicable or usable for many different purposes rather than being specialized for one particular use.

examples.japanese: {汎用|はんよう}コンピュータ
この{部品|ぶひん}は{汎用性|はんようせい}が{高|たか}い。
{汎用|はんよう}{製品|せいひん}は{専門|せんもん}{製品|せいひん}より{安価|あんか}なことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: General-purpose products are often cheaper than specialized ones.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used as a noun modifier ({汎用|はんよう}〜) or with the suffix {性|せい} ({汎用性|はんようせい}) to describe versatility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{汎用|はんよう}コンピュータ - general-purpose computer
・{汎用|はんよう}ソフトウェア - general-purpose software
・{汎用|はんよう}{機|き} - general-purpose machine
・{汎用性|はんようせい}が{高|たか}い - highly versatile

CONTRAST:
{専用|せんよう} (dedicated, specialized) is the opposite of {汎用|はんよう}.
